# Gyusang (Kevin) Hwang

I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Tourism & Hospitality Management at Temple University's Fox School of Business. My work integrates **industry experience, research, and teaching**, using large-scale data, econometrics, and spatial analytics to examine tourism, hospitality, and event phenomena.

Before entering academia, I worked across business travel and MICE, mega-events, and hospitality operations. These experiences continue to inform the questions I study and the applied perspectives I bring into the classroom.

::: {.job-market-note}
**2026–2027 Academic Job Market**  
I am currently seeking faculty opportunities in tourism, hospitality, and related business disciplines.
:::
